objective: Unchanged focal plus 5*L1 plus 2*GIoU, add mean smooth-L1(log(predicted_size/true_size)) at supervised noncolliding centers only
checkpoint_policy: Final epoch80 only, no sweep or intermediate selection
training_gate: Both seeds must improve decoded known blue target coverage on extra public FIT scenes, without reducing known red coverage there or known red/blue coverage on original FIT scenes. Do not use holdout to choose an epoch or penalty weight.
evaluation: After training gate, export with unchanged decoder and evaluate both seeds on all three repeated development panels with unchanged classifier, thresholds and crop budget. Independent Pi-camera qualification remains required.
